name: cochlea-mcp
description: Render, analyze, and verify audio (WAV/FLAC/mp3/ogg) offline and deterministically, exposed as MCP tools.
long_description: Cochlea is a headless, deterministic audio engine. This server exposes it as MCP tools: render a declarative score to byte-identical PCM, extract loudness/pitch/melody/timbre/tempo/key/structure reports from any WAV, FLAC, mp3, or ogg file, generate plain or annotated spectrograms, diff two renders in feature space or as a spectral heat map, import Standard MIDI Files as scores, and transcribe audio back into an editable score. No ffmpeg, no audio device, no realtime path.

tools.name: render_score
tools.description: Render a cochlea RON score to a deterministic WAV mix, optionally running its embedded verify assertions.

tools.name: probe_audio
tools.description: Extract the full feature report (loudness, onsets, pitch and melody notes, MFCC timbre, key, a chord timeline and per-section key, tempo, rhythm grid, stereo, structure) from a WAV, FLAC, mp3, or ogg file, optionally windowed to a time range.

tools.name: spectrogram
tools.description: Render a mel spectrogram PNG — plain, annotated with detected beats/onsets/pitch, or as a tiled contact sheet — from a WAV, FLAC, mp3, or ogg file.

tools.name: lint_score
tools.description: Statically validate a RON score against the instrument/preset catalog without rendering audio.

tools.name: probe_digest
tools.description: A compact text digest of a WAV, FLAC, mp3, or ogg file, sized for an LLM's context window.

tools.name: audio_diff
tools.description: Compare two audio files in feature space — byte-identical, tier-2 equivalent, or different — optionally with a signed spectral-difference heat map.

tools.name: score_reference
tools.description: The complete score-authoring reference: RON grammar, live instrument-preset catalog, verify assertions, and a worked example.

tools.name: import_midi
tools.description: Convert a Standard MIDI File (format 0/1) to a RON score with exact timing and preset-family mapping guesses listed for re-voicing.

tools.name: export_midi
tools.description: Convert a cochlea RON score to a Standard MIDI File (format 1) — the inverse of import_midi, with exact timing and rough General MIDI instrument labels.

tools.name: loudness_timeline
tools.description: The whole-file loudness-over-time curve as JSON: momentary (400 ms) and short-term (3 s) LUFS sampled at a fixed hop, each point timed from the start of the file — the dynamics view the single integrated-LUFS summary can't give.

tools.name: beat_grid
tools.description: The whole-file beat grid as JSON: every detected beat time, the estimated downbeats, the tempo with its octave candidates, and a stability score — the per-beat detail the compact tempo summary drops.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a WAV, FLAC, mp3, or ogg file into an editable RON score — the inverse of render_score. Monophonic pitch tracking against a detected or given tempo, quantized to a note grid, with every guess reported.
